blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Existing depth-from-focus methods can struggle with weak focus cues, new cameras, or fewer focal slices. We present FocusAnchor, a recurrent model that uses focus-volume lookups to refine metric depth and repeatedly aligns a relative depth prior from a frozen foundation model to the current depth estimate. The aligned prior guides subsequent refinement in a feedback loop, carrying metric scale recovered from textured regions into regions where focus cues are weak while preserving scene structure. To support transfer across cameras, we synthesize training stacks with randomized camera parameters and focus distances. However, stack synthesis blurs existing image noise differently across slices, creating artificial depth cues even on textureless surfaces. We add independent per-slice noise to suppress these cues. We also introduce variable-stack training to improve robustness with fewer focal slices and support more practical mobile capture. Compared with FOSSA ViT-B, FocusAnchor reduces AbsRel by 36% on NYU Depth V2 and by 9% on DDFF-12 after fine-tuning. In zero-shot evaluation, FocusAnchor and its variable-stack variant, FocusAnchor-flex, achieve the two lowest AbsRel values on all five benchmarks. On ZEDD test, FocusAnchor achieves 9% lower AbsRel than the best competing method, FOSSA ViT-B, while FocusAnchor-flex achieves lower AbsRel with 40% fewer focal slices on ZEDD validation.
blocks.zh: 现有的从焦点入手的深度方法可以和弱的焦点提示,新的相机,或者更少的焦距片一起挣扎. 我们提出FocusAnchor,这是一种经常性的模式,它利用焦点量的检查来完善度量深度,并反复将从被冻结的基础模型到当前深度估计之前的相对深度相匹配. 之前经过调整的指南随后在反馈回路中进行了完善,将从有纹理区域恢复到重点提示薄弱的区域,同时保留了场景结构。 为了支持跨相机的传输,我们用随机相机参数和焦距合成了训练堆. 然而,堆栈合成在切片间不同地模糊了现有的图像噪声,甚至在无纹理地表上也会产生人工的深度提示. 我们添加独立的单片噪音来抑制这些提示. 我们还实行可变堆积培训,以降低焦距来提高稳健性,并支持更实用的移动捕捉. 与FOSSA VIT-B相比,FocusAnchor在NYU Depth V2上将AbsRel减少36%,在微调后将DDFF-12减少9%. 在零发评价中,FocusAnchor及其可变-sack变体"FocusAnchor-flex"在所有五个基准上都实现了两个最低的AbsRel值. 在ZED测试上,FocusAnchor的AbsRel比最佳相竞方法FOSSA ViT-B低了9%,而FocusAnchor-flex的AbsRel在ZED验证上以40%的焦点片少了40%.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Metric depth estimation predicts the distance from a camera to visible surfaces in meters. The metric depths are useful because they enable applications such as augmented reality to correctly scale and position virtual objects [ 7 ] , and help robots judge distances for obstacle avoidance and manipulation [ 22 ] .
Camera focus can provide a metric cue because surfaces appear sharpest when focused at their distance.
Capturing the same scene at several known focus distances produces a focal stack, with each image called a focal slice . Depth-from-focus (DFF) models [ 17 , 27 , 30 , 29 , 8 ] estimate metric depth from sharpness changes across slices and their known focus distances. However, changes in sharpness are not equally informative across the image. Textured regions often provide informative focus cues, while smooth walls and other textureless surfaces can look similar across slices, making their depth difficult to determine.
blocks.zh:
量子深度估计预测了从相机到以米计可见的表面的距离. 度量深度是有用的,因为它使诸如增强现实等应用能够正确缩放和定位虚拟对象[7],并帮助机器人判断距离以避免障碍和操纵[22].
相机焦距可以提供一个度量的提示,因为表面在焦距时看起来最尖锐.
在几个已知的焦距上捕捉同一场景会产生一个焦距堆栈,每个图像称为焦距切片 。 深度从焦点(DFF)模型[17,27,30,29,8]从切片的锐度变化及其已知的焦距估计出测量深度. 然而,在整个图像中,锐度的变化并没有得到同样的信息。 纹理区往往提供信息化的焦点提示,而光滑的墙壁和其他无纹理的表面则可以在切片间看起来相似,使其深度难以确定.

blocks.en: Relative-depth foundation models such as Depth Anything V2 [ 32 ] can provide complementary scene structure from a single image, including where focus cues are weak, but their predictions lack metric scale. HybridDepth [ 8 ] aligns a monocular depth estimate with a focus-based estimate and refines the result. FOSSA [ 34 ] adapts a pretrained depth model to focal stacks, demonstrating zero-shot transfer to new cameras and scenes.
blocks.zh: 相对深入的基础模型如深度Anything V2[32]可以从单一图像中提供互补的场景结构,包括焦点提示弱的地方,但其预测缺乏度量尺度. Hybrid Depth [8] 将一个单元深度估计与一个基于焦点的估计相配合,并完善结果. 自由和开放源码软件 [34] 将一个预先训练的深度模型适用于焦堆,显示零镜头传输到新的相机和场景.

blocks.en: Despite these advances, three limitations remain. First , metric depth can remain inaccurate in regions with weak focus cues, particularly textureless surfaces. Second , achieving strong generalization with limited task-specific training data remains challenging. FOSSA, for example, is trained on stacks rendered from 373k synthetic images. Third , existing methods often lose accuracy with fewer focal slices, limiting their use when capture time or scene motion restricts stack size. On an iPhone 18 Pro, we measure about 0.58 s per slice and 2.9 s for five slices ( Sec. 4.4 ).
blocks.zh: 尽管取得了这些进展,但仍有三个限制。 首先,在焦距小的区域,特别是无纹理的表面,度量深度可能仍然不准确。 第二,以有限的特定任务培训数据实现强有力的普及仍然是一项挑战。 例如,自由和开放源码软件是用373k合成图像制成的堆栈进行训练的。 第三,现有方法往往以较少的焦片失去精度,在捕捉时间或场景运动时限制其使用,限制堆栈大小. 在iPhone 18 Pro上,我们测量每片约0.58秒,5片约2.9秒(第4.4节)。

blocks.en: We introduce FocusAnchor, a recurrent DFF model built around a feedback loop between depth refinement and prior alignment ( ). Given a focal stack, its focus distances, and an all-in-focus image, FocusAnchor maps a frozen foundation model’s relative depth prediction onto the focus range. A recurrent network refines this estimate through lookups in a focus volume, which stores learned scores across focal slices at each pixel. After initial scale adjustment, each refinement step fits the frozen prediction to the current estimate using a confidence-weighted local scale and shift. The aligned prior and focus evidence guide the next update, carrying metric scale recovered from textured regions into regions where focus cues are weak.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了FocusAnchor(FocusAnchor),这是一种反复出现的DFF模型,它围绕深度改进和前置调整之间的反馈循环构建(.). FocusAnchor将冻结的基础模型的相对深度预测映射到焦点范围。 一个经常性的网络通过一个焦点卷的检索来完善这一估计,该卷存储在每个像素的焦片间学到的分数. 经过初步的比额表调整后,每个完善步骤都采用置信加权的局部尺度和移位法,将冻结的预测与目前的估计相匹配. 一致的事先证据和重点证据为下一次更新提供指导,将从纹理区域回收的尺度带入重点提示薄弱的区域。

blocks.en:
To support cross-camera transfer, we train the refinement network under varied acquisition conditions using NYU Depth V2 images. Following FOSSA, we synthesize focal stacks with randomized camera parameters and focus distances. However, during the synthesis process, blurring a captured RGB image also smooths the sensor noise already present. At each pixel, this noise is smoothed least in the slice focused at the surface’s depth, creating an artificial depth cue even on textureless surfaces. A model can therefore learn to locate the in-focus slice from residual noise rather than scene detail. This shortcut does not reflect real capture, where sensor noise is introduced separately in each exposure rather than blurred with the scene. We therefore add independent random noise to each rendered slice to suppress this shortcut.
To support different capture budgets, we also train a variant with two to five focal slices, FocusAnchor-flex.
blocks.zh:
为了支持跨相机的传输,我们利用NYU Depth V2图像,在不同的获取条件下培训完善网络. 遵循自由和开放源码软件,我们用随机化的相机参数和焦距合成焦堆。 然而,在合成过程中,模糊一个捕获的RGB图像也使已经存在的传感器噪声平滑. 在每一像素上,这种噪音在以地表深度为焦点的切片中最不平滑,甚至在无纹理的表面也会产生人工的深度提示. 因此,一个模型可以学会从残留噪音中找到聚焦片段,而不是场景细节。 这种快捷方式并不反映真实的捕捉,在每次接触时都会分别引入传感器噪声,而不是与场景模糊. 因此,我们在每个制成的切片上添加独立的随机噪声来压制这个快捷键.
为了支持不同的捕捉预算,我们还训练了一个变体,带有2到5个焦片,FocusAnchor-flex.

blocks.en: FocusAnchor achieves strong accuracy on held-out NYU Depth V2 images and on DDFF-12 after fine-tuning. Without target-dataset fine-tuning, FocusAnchor and FocusAnchor-flex achieve the two lowest AbsRel values across five benchmarks, including real captured focal stacks in ZEDD, where FocusAnchor reduces AbsRel by about 9% relative to FOSSA ViT-B on the public test set. With variable-stack training, FocusAnchor-flex maintains strong performance across stack sizes. On ZEDD validation, FocusAnchor-flex achieves 73% lower AbsRel than FOSSA ViT-B when both use two slices and achieves lower AbsRel with three slices than FOSSA ViT-B with five. These results suggest potential for mobile capture with fewer exposures.
blocks.zh: FocusAnchor在牵引出NYU深度V2图像和DDFF-12微调后实现强精度. 没有目标数据集的微调,FocusAnchor和FocusAnchor-flex实现了两个最低的 AbsRel 值跨越五个基准,包括ZEDD中真实捕获的焦堆,其中FocusAnchor减少 AbsRel在公共测试集上相对于自由和开放源码软件A VIT-B的大约9%. 通过可变堆积训练,FocusAnchor-flex保持了跨堆积大小的强性能. 在ZED验证上,FocusAnchor-flex在使用两个切片时比FOSSA VIT-B的AbsRel低73%,在使用三个切片时比FOSSA ViT-B的AbsRel低73%. 这些结果表明,移动捕捉的可能性较小。

blocks.en: Our main contributions are: • A recurrent DFF architecture that updates depth in units of focus planes and repeatedly aligns a frozen depth prior to the current estimate to guide refinement. • A training recipe combining randomized camera parameters and independent per-slice noise to suppress artificial depth cues from synthetic stack rendering and support transfer to real captured stacks. • Robustness across focal-stack sizes through variable-stack training that enables FocusAnchor-flex to support two to five slices and outperforms competing methods with two or three slices on ZEDD. • State-of-the-art zero-shot AbsRel on ZEDD, Infinigen Defocus, iBims, HAMMER, and ARKitScenes.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要贡献是: • 一个经常性的DFF架构,在焦点平面单位中更新深度,并在目前估计值之前反复调整一个冻结深度,以指导完善. • 支助 将随机相机参数和独立的每片噪声相结合的训练食谱,以压制人工深度提示,从合成堆栈渲染和支持转移到真正的捕获堆栈. • 通过可变堆式培训,使FocusAnchor-flex能够支持2至5个切片,并在ZED上用2至3个切片进行比对,从而在焦层大小之间保持强健。 • ZEDD、Infinigen De Focus、iBims、HAMMER和ARKitScens上最先进的零镜头AbsRel。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Depth from focus. Early DFF methods estimate depth using handcrafted sharpness measures across focal settings [ 25 ] . DDFF [ 9 ] introduced end-to-end DFF and the DDFF-12 light-field benchmark, while DefocusNet [ 17 ] narrowed the synthetic-to-real gap with a defocus-aware architecture and the FoD500 dataset.
DFV [ 30 ] uses a differential focus volume from neighboring-slice feature differences and estimates a distribution over focus distances, while DualFocus [ 29 ] adds spatial and focal variational constraints to distinguish depth boundaries from texture artifacts and to encourage physically consistent training.
We adapt DFV’s focus volume for recurrent depth refinement.
blocks.zh:
深度从焦. 早期的DFF方法使用人工制作的跨焦距的锐度测量法估算深度[25]. DDFF [9] 引入了端对端的DFF和DDFF-12光场基准,而DeFocusNet [17] 则用一个解聚焦的架构和FOD500数据集缩小了合成到实际的差距.
DFV [30] 使用来自相邻-剪切特征差异的差焦量,并估计焦距的分布,而DualFocus [29] 增加了空间和焦变限制,以区分深度界限和纹理文物,并鼓励物理训练一致.

blocks.en:
Single-image depth estimation. Relative depth models predict depth only up to an unknown scale and shift.
MiDaS [ 21 ] and Depth Anything [ 31 ] generalize across domains through diverse training data, and Depth Anything V2 [ 32 ] adds robustness and fine detail.
Marigold [ 13 ] repurposes a pretrained diffusion model for zero-shot depth.
Metric depth models predict depth in meters from learned scene priors, often with known or estimated intrinsics.
ZoeDepth [ 4 ] adds metric heads to relative-depth training.
Metric3D, Metric3D v2 and DA3 Metric [ 33 , 10 , 15 ] predict depth in a canonical camera space and rescale predictions using the input focal length.
UniDepth and UniDepth V2 [ 18 , 19 ] predict camera geometry alongside depth, and Depth Pro [ 5 ] estimates the focal length, enabling metric prediction without supplied intrinsics.
However, the single-image models we evaluated still incur large metric errors on ZEDD ( Tab. 3 ).
We instead anchor a relative depth prior using focus observations at known distances.
blocks.zh:
单象深度估计. 相对深度模型只预测深度到未知尺度和转移.
MiDAS [21] 和深度任何东西[31] 通过不同的培训数据对各个领域进行概括,深度任何东西V2 [32] 增加了强性和细微细节.
Marigold [13] 重新设计了一种0射深度的预训扩散模型.
量子深度模型从已学到的场景前期以米数预测深度,往往带有已知或估计的内在特征.
Zoe Depth [4] 在相对深入的训练中增加了度量头.
Metric3D,Metric3D v2和DA3 Metric [33, 10, 15] 预测峡谷相机空间的深度,并使用输入焦距重新进行预测.
UniDepth和UniDepth V2 [18,19] 预测相机几何与深度并列,而Deph Pro [5] 估计焦距,在不提供内在内容的情况下,能够进行测量预测.
然而,我们所评价的单一图像模型仍然在ZEDD上出现很大的公尺误差(图3)。
在使用已知距离的焦点观测之前,我们先锁定一个相对深度。

blocks.en:
Fusing focus with single-image priors. HybridDepth [ 8 ] aligns a relative single-image depth map to a DFF estimate with a global scale and shift, then applies learned pixelwise scale corrections.
FOSSA [ 34 ] integrates focus cues into a pretrained metric depth transformer through attention across slices and an embedding of each focus distance.
In stereo, MonSter [ 6 ] aligns a monocular prior inside a recurrent loop through learned per-pixel shift updates.
We instead align the prior in closed form with a local scale and shift before every step, and combine it with focus-volume lookups in units of focus planes.
blocks.zh:
将焦点与单像前传融合. Hybrid Depth [8] 将相对的单像深度图与一个DFF估计值与全局尺度和偏移相配合,然后应用学到的像素尺度校正.
自由和开放源码软件[34]通过对切片的注意和对每个焦距的嵌入,将焦点纳入预先训练过的度量深度变压器。
在立体声中,MonSter [6]通过每个像素学习到的变换更新,在反复循环之前将一个单体对齐.
相反,我们把先前的封闭式与局部尺度统一起来,在每一步骤之前转移,并将其与焦点平面单位的焦点量检查相结合。

blocks.en:
Recurrent refinement with depth priors. RAFT [ 26 ] and RAFT-Stereo [ 16 ] iteratively refine optical flow and disparity, respectively, using ConvGRUs guided by features retrieved from correlation volumes.
DEFOM-Stereo [ 11 ] initializes disparity from Depth Anything V2 and applies scale updates before additive refinement.Stereo Anywhere [ 2 ] combines correlation volumes derived from stereo image features and monocular depth predictions.
We extend DEFOM-Stereo’s recurrent backbone with focus-volume lookups and depth updates relative to known focus planes.
blocks.zh:
不断改进前述深度。 RAFT [26] 和RAFT-Stereo [16] 分别利用从相关量检索到的特性为指导的ConvGRUs,迭代精炼光学流和差异.
DEFOM-Stereo [11]从深度任意V2中初始化差异,并在添加剂完善前应用比例更新. Stereo Anywhere [2] 结合了从立体图像特征和单极深度预测中得出的相关量.
我们扩展了DEFOM-Stereo的经常主干线,与已知的焦点平面相比,有焦点量的检查和深度更新。

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en:
Given a focal stack { I i } i = 1 N \{I_{i}\}_{i=1}^{N} with known focus distances d 1 < ⋯ < d N d_{1}<\dots<d_{N} in meters and an all-in-focus image I aif I_{\text{aif}} , we estimate a metric depth map D D . Figure 2 shows the architecture of FocusAnchor, where a CNN encodes the focal stack into a focus volume that scores the sharpness of each pixel in each slice, and a frozen Depth Anything V2 predicts the relative inverse depth from the all-in-focus image.
We map this prediction onto the focus range and recurrently correct its scale before refining it in focus-plane coordinates. During the latter stage, each iteration aligns the prior to the current estimate and uses the aligned prior together with focus-volume lookups to guide the next update.
Building on DEFOM-Stereo’s recurrent backbone [ 11 ] , we introduce focus-plane lookups and updates ( Sec. 3.3 ), repeated prior alignment ( Sec. 3.4 ), and per-slice noise and variable-stack training ( Sec. 3.6 ).

blocks.en:
RAFT-based update loop. We combine the volume with the prior through the update loop of RAFT-Stereo [ 26 , 16 ] , which refines an estimate at 1 / 4 1/4 resolution over several iterations.
In each iteration, a lookup reads the volume around the current estimate.
A ConvGRU takes the lookup, the estimate and fixed context features, and predicts a correction.
GRU weights are shared within each stage, and a learned convex upsampling gives the full-resolution output.
From DEFOM-Stereo [ 11 ] we keep two ideas: the loop starts from the single-image prior, and its first iterations rescale the estimate before the rest add corrections.

在每次迭代中,一个检索会读取围绕当前估计数的音量.

3.6 Training
blocks.zh: 3.6 培训

blocks.en:
We train FocusAnchor on NYU Depth V2 [ 24 ] , rendering focal stacks with FOSSA’s render [ 34 ] .
Camera parameters and focus distances vary per image to support cross-camera transfer (Suppl. Sec. 7 ).
FocusAnchor-flex is the same architecture trained with variable stacks ( Sec. 4.4 ).
We address the following two sources of artificial depth cues.
blocks.zh:
我们用NYU的深度V2[24]来训练FocusAnchor,
每个图像的相机参数和焦距不同,以支持跨相机传输(Supplement. Sec.7 ).
FocusAnchor-flex是同一种以可变堆栈(sec. 4.4)训练的建筑.
我们处理以下两个人为深度提示的来源。

blocks.en:
Focus planes. Prior focal-stack methods [ 8 , 29 ] place the nearest and farthest planes at each image’s minimum and maximum ground-truth depth, so the network only places pixels between two known depths (Suppl. Fig. 4 ).
Following FOSSA, 80% of our stacks instead use random focus distances, with the nearest plane at 0.6 to 1 m and the farthest 7 to 15 times farther.
blocks.zh:
聚焦飞机 先前的焦距计 [8, 29] 将最近和最远的平面放置在每个图像最小和最大地面真实深度, 因此网络只将像素放置在两个已知深度之间( Supp. Fig. 4 ) 。
在自由和开放源码软件之后,我们80%的堆栈使用随机聚焦距离,最近的平面为0.6至1米,最远的7至15倍。

blocks.en:
Per-slice noise. The renderer blurs one sharp photo once per focus distance, so the photo’s sensor noise stays sharpest in the slice that is in focus.
On a textureless surface, such as a white wall, this noise is the only detail, so its sharpest slice hints at the depth. A real camera exposes every slice separately, with new noise each time, so we add fresh Gaussian noise to every rendered slice.
If textureless pixels carried no depth hint, their sharpest slice would be the one focused nearest the true depth 20% of the time, one in five.
In our renders this happens 62% of the time, and the added noise lowers it to 27% (Suppl. Sec. 7 ).
blocks.zh:
双虱声. 渲染器每焦距模糊一张尖锐的照片,所以照片的感应噪音在焦距的切片中保持最尖锐.
在无纹状的表面,如白色的墙壁上,这种噪音是唯一的细节,因此其最尖锐的切片提示在深度. 一个真实的相机将每个切片分别曝光,每次都有新的噪音,所以我们在每个变形的切片中加入新鲜的高斯噪音.
如果无纹理的像素没有带深度提示,那么它们最尖锐的切片将是最接近真实深度的20%,即五分之一的时间.
再加上噪音, 则降低至27%(第7节)。

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en:
We evaluate three aspects of FocusAnchor: (i) generalization across scene and camera domains, (ii) sensitivity to focal-stack size, and (iii) the contributions of prior alignment and iterative refinement. Trained only on NYU Depth V2, FocusAnchor and FocusAnchor-flex achieve the two lowest AbsRel values on all five zero-shot benchmarks ( Tab. 3 ).
FocusAnchor-flex remains accurate with as few as two slices, which suggests practical utility when a long focal stack cannot be captured.

我们评价FocusAnchor的三个方面:(一) 跨场景域和相机域的概括性,(二) 对焦层大小的敏感性,以及(三) 事先调整和迭代改进的贡献。 仅接受过NYU深度V2,FocusAnchor和FocusAnchor-flex的训练,在所有五个零射线基准上都达到了两个最低的AbsRel值(Tab.
FocusAnchor-flex仍然准确,只有两个切片,这说明当一个长焦堆无法捕捉到时,实用效用.

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: Datasets. Our evaluation covers captured, light-field-refocused, and synthetic focal stacks.
blocks.zh: 数据集. 我们的评价包括捕捉到的,轻场重心, 和合成的焦堆。

blocks.en: • NYU Depth V2 [ 24 ] contains indoor RGB-D images, with 24,231 training and 654 test images in our split. We evaluate on the test images following prior work [ 8 , 29 ] , with focus planes spanning each image’s ground-truth depth range. • DDFF-12 [ 9 ] provides focal stacks refocused from light-field images of 12 indoor scenes. We use five-slice inputs and follow prior protocols [ 9 , 30 ] for comparison. • ZEDD [ 34 ] provides focal stacks captured with a full-frame camera and a 50 mm lens, with dense LiDAR ground-truth. We evaluate its validation and test splits, each containing 50 scenes. We follow FOSSA evaluation and test protocols. Inputs are resized and center-cropped to 480 × 640 480\times 640 , with valid ground-truth depths restricted to [ 0.01 , 1000 ] [0.01,1000] m. • Infinigen Defocus [ 34 ] is a synthetic benchmark containing 200 indoor scenes generated with Infinigen Indoors [ 20 ] and rendered with defocus in Blender Cycles. Following FOSSA, we use five images per scene at F/1.4, with focus distances of 0.8, 1.7, 3.0, 4.7, and 8.0 m, retaining ground-truth depths in [ 0.01 , 1000 ] [0.01,1000] m. For FocusAnchor, RGB images and depth maps are resized to 480 × 640 480\times 640 using Lanczos and nearest-neighbor interpolation, respectively. • iBims, HAMMER, and ARKitScenes provide RGB-D images without focal stacks. Practical capture and inference implications. Acquiring a focal stack requires repeated focus adjustments and photo captures.
On iOS, processing to improve photo quality can further delay image delivery [ 1 ] .
Longer acquisition windows also make it harder to maintain a consistent viewpoint and scene during handheld capture.
We quantify this cost using an iOS app on an iPhone 18 Pro that locks the lens at five evenly spaced focus positions and captures each photo once the lens has settled. Across 10 trials, a five-slice stack takes 2.89 s on average, and photo capture is 85% of the 579 ms per slice (supplementary Tab. 7 ).
Reducing the stack to two slices thus shortens acquisition by 60%, about 1.7 s, under this protocol.
Together with its stronger accuracy than the compared methods at two slices ( Tab. 4 ), FocusAnchor-flex offers a practical tradeoff between depth accuracy and acquisition time, allowing fewer focal slices at inference when capture time is limited.

blocks.en: Complementary cues ( Tab. 5 ). The full model outperforms either single-cue estimate on all three datasets. blocks.en: Prior alignment. Tab. 5 shows that fitting the prior only once after the scale stage, while retaining it as a GRU input, increases AbsRel by approximately 4-10% relative to the full model. Training with the NYU evaluation camera configuration improves NYU accuracy but reduces transfer to other cameras: ZEDD AbsRel roughly doubles, and ARKitScenes AbsRel increases by 76%. blocks.en: Refinement iterations. With five slices, the four scale iterations provide most of the accuracy gain. Reducing subsequent step iterations from twelve to eight keeps AbsRel within 1.3% of the default for both models across all three datasets and reduces inference time by 10%. blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: FocusAnchor uses an aligned foundation-model depth prior to carry metric scale recovered from textured regions into regions where focus cues are weak. FocusAnchor and FocusAnchor-flex achieve competitive zero-shot performance, and ablations demonstrate the benefits of repeatedly aligning the prior with focus-derived depth estimates throughout refinement. Our variable-stack training supports shorter focal stacks, but does not explicitly account for camera or scene motion during acquisition. Future work could incorporate these effects into model design and training to improve robustness in handheld capture.

blocks.zh: 9 手机焦距捕获时间

blocks.en: Table 7 : Focal-stack capture time on a phone. iPhone 18 Pro, standard photo API, 10 five-slice stacks (50 slices). Every photo was exposed after the lens had settled.
blocks.zh: 表 7: 手机的焦距记录时间。 iPhone 18 Pro,标准照片API,10个五片堆(50片). 每张照片都在镜头平定后曝光.

blocks.en:
Table 7 breaks down the time to capture a focal stack on a phone.
Our iOS app moves the lens to five evenly spaced positions across its focus range.
At each position, it waits until the lens has settled and then requests a photo.
Photo capture takes 85% of each slice, and the lens move takes the remaining 15%.
Within capture, the shutter fires about 0.1 s after the request, and the photo is delivered about 0.39 s later.
Because every slice costs about the same, stack time grows linearly with the number of slices.
Each five-slice stack equals the sum of its slices to within 2 ms.
We did not time two-slice stacks directly.
Summing the nearest and farthest slices of each run gives an estimate of 1.16 ± \pm 0.02 s, 60% less than a five-slice stack.

在每一个位置,它都等到镜头定下来,然后要求拍照.
照片捕捉每片占85%,镜头移动则占其余15%.
在捕捉范围内,百叶窗在请求后发射约0.1秒,照片在后期发送约0.39秒.

The focus planes give both of our models the metric scale. On every row, the median ratio of our depth to the ground truth lies within 7% of one.
DA3 Metric-L has to infer the scale from the image alone, and its maps often have the right shape at the wrong scale. One scale factor per image removes most of its error on 8 of the 15 rows.
